title: Weak-model review output contract (review mode)
description: JSON counterpart of the markdown review template checked by scripts/check_ai_protocol.py --mode review. Findings are structured objects: an empty array means 'none' (the markdown 'none' value). Aligned checks: all five sections required; every finding entry must carry a file:line citation (pattern enforced here, same regex as the markdown checker); an APPROVE verdict requires non-empty harness coverage without 'NOT VERIFIED' (checker code); non-empty findings require non-empty harness coverage (checker code); total lines must not exceed the review budget of 20 (LINE_BUDGETS.review); forbidden noise phrases rejected.

blocking_findings.description: Blocking findings: tier (N) or hard-gate violations; empty array = none.

high_findings.description: High findings: (C)-tier issues needing fix or documented justification; empty array = none.

harness_coverage.description: Harness coverage: which harnesses were applied and whether the coverage is verified.

verdict.description: Verdict: e.g. APPROVE, REQUEST CHANGES. APPROVE requires verified harness coverage.

text.description: The finding, including its tier tag and [Rx] citation labels.

citation.description: file:line citation for the finding (same regex as the markdown checker).
